mapper.insert: INSERT INTO APPROVAL_HISTORY ( DOC_ID, APPROVER_ID, ACTION, COMMENTS, ACTION_DATE, APPROVAL_ORDER ) VALUES ( #{docId}, #{approverId}, #{action}, #{commentText}, NOW(), #{approvalOrder} )

INSERT INTO APPROVAL_HISTORY ( DOC_ID, APPROVER_ID, APPROVAL_ORDER, ACTION, ACTION_DATE ) VALUES
( #{h.docId}, #{h.approverId}, #{h.approvalOrder}, #{h.action}, #{h.actionDate} )
mapper.update: UPDATE APPROVAL_HISTORY SET ACTION = #{action}, COMMENTS = #{commentText}, ACTION_DATE = NOW() WHERE HISTORY_ID = #{historyId}
mapper.select: SELECT HISTORY_ID, DOC_ID, APPROVER_ID, APPROVAL_ORDER, ACTION, COMMENTS, ACTION_DATE FROM APPROVAL_HISTORY WHERE DOC_ID = #{docId} AND ACTION = 'PENDING' ORDER BY APPROVAL_ORDER ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT AH.HISTORY_ID, AH.DOC_ID, AH.APPROVER_ID, AH.APPROVAL_ORDER, AH.ACTION, AH.COMMENTS, AH.ACTION_DATE, U.NAME AS APPROVER_NAME, U.RANK_NAME AS APPROVER_RANK FROM APPROVAL_HISTORY AH JOIN USERS U ON AH.APPROVER_ID = U.ID WHERE AH.DOC_ID = #{docId} AND AH.APPROVAL_ORDER = #{currentOrder} + 1 ORDER BY AH.APPROVAL_ORDER ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT AH.HISTORY_ID, AH.DOC_ID, AH.APPROVER_ID, AH.APPROVAL_ORDER, AH.ACTION, AH.COMMENTS, AH.ACTION_DATE, U.NAME AS APPROVER_NAME, U.RANK_NAME AS APPROVER_RANK FROM APPROVAL_HISTORY AH JOIN USERS U ON AH.APPROVER_ID = U.ID WHERE AH.DOC_ID = #{docId} ORDER BY AH.APPROVAL_ORDER ASC
